page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.6xlarge is a general-purpose cloud instance configured with 24 vCPUs across 12 physical cores, utilizing Intel Xeon 8163 processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz on x86_64 architecture. Hyper-Threading is enabled with two threads per core under a KVM hypervisor. The instance features 96 GiB of memory, yielding 4.0 GiB per vCPU. Hardware cache specifications include 32 KB L1d cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache per core, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. Supported CPU instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512, AVX512_VNNI, AES, BMI2, ADX, and FMA. It includes an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, contains no local NVMe storage, and does not incorporate dedicated GPU hardware accelerators.

Benchmark evaluation shows average multi-core compute capabilities alongside lower relative single-core efficiency. The instance achieved a multi-core stress-ng result of 17544.06 and a PassMark CPU score of 18227.84. Single-core processing metrics rank in lower tiers, recorded at 1107.98 on stress-ng and 1008.0 on Geekbench single-core tests. Single-threaded gzip compression measured 19.24 GB/sec. Memory bandwidth testing yielded 986.24 GB/sec for small cached block reads, 90.15 GB/sec for large uncached block reads, and 50.79 GB/sec for large uncached block writes.

The 1:4 CPU-to-memory ratio provides balanced hardware density for standard application hosting without heavily favoring memory or compute capacity. In database and application benchmarks, the server produced 16.81 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and a static web serving throughput of 13.07 GB/sec. Small LLM prompt processing achieved 1084.68 tokens/sec on a 135M model, dropping to 30.14 tokens/sec on a 7B model. Because local disk storage is absent, external cloud block storage is required. The instance is suited for multi-threaded backend services, web server clusters, software compilation pipelines, and caching layers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.6xlarge is a general-purpose instance powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8163 processor on x86_64 architecture, providing 12 physical cores, 24 vCPUs, and 96 GiB of system RAM. It incorporates an 8 Gbps baseline network speed, operates under a KVM hypervisor, and contains no local storage or GPUs. Performance testing demonstrates solid multi-threaded capability with a PassMark CPU score of 18227.84 and a multi-core stress-ng score of 17544.06, though single-core performance registers lower across Geekbench and gzip compression tests. Large uncached block memory read throughput reaches 90.15 GB/sec. In application benchmarks, it yields 16.81 million operations per second on Redis SET tasks and 13.07 GB/sec in static web serving. The balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio aligns with microservices, web application servers, CI/CD build environments, and in-memory caching platforms.
